data.one_liner: A state management library for Dart and Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StateManager class to handle application state transitions, handle asynchronous operations with automatic error reporting, and monitor changes using state observers and global overrides.
use_when: You need a structured state management solution for Dart or Flutter.
You want built-in support for error handling and global state change observation.
You want a lightweight state manager without code generation requirements.
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time safe immutable models generated via build_runner.
You are already deeply invested in an alternative state management library like Bloc or Riverpod.
strengths: Built-in error handling and error reporting mechanisms.
State observers allow easy monitoring for debugging and analytics.
Global overrides for customizing state emission behavior.
weaknesses: Limited community and ecosystem compared to older, dominant alternatives like Bloc or Riverpod.
Relies on manual state class definitions and equality overrides.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a heavily battle-tested, event-driven state management library with extensive tooling and community support.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want compile-time safe, provider-based state management that prevents scoping bugs.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a lightweight, inherited-widget-based dependency injection and state management approach.
